objections.about: The customer asks whether Blotato is down, which is an outage question. The help pages shown give no way to confirm Blotato's own status, so a person should answer it.
The reply never says directly whether Blotato is down. It only implies that the wrong URL caused the DNS error.

Step 3 is about an agent reporting a 'persistent API error' and reading the Logs. The customer reported a DNS error for api.blotato.com, which the page says comes from a wrong URL. Also, the customer never said which integration they use, so it is unclear whether the REST or MCP URL applies.
